about:
Kansas Coil Spring Company operates from Wichita, Kansas, where it has produced aviation springs and wire forms for more than three decades. The company does not publicly disclose its founding year or ownership structure, but its staff collectively holds over 100 years of manufacturing experience.

The company specializes in custom spring and wire form manufacturing, providing engineering and design assistance through to production and delivery. It serves a range of sectors with certified aviation-grade components, though specific facility size, headcount, and annual volumes are not disclosed.

Its customer base spans aerospace, agriculture, oil and gas, and U.S. government agencies. The company highlights its work on aviation springs and wire forms for these sectors.

The company emphasizes its AS9100D and ISO 9001:2015 certifications and its ability to provide full technical support from design through delivery as key differentiators.
